title: How Untreated HIV Triggers Lymph Node Bystander Pyroptosis

teenKit.tldr: Untreated HIV doesn't just kill the cells it directly infects; it tricks the immune system's alarm network into accidentally destroying 95% of uninfected bystander cells.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Understanding how our own cellular security systems can be weaponized against us transforms how we design future treatments for viral infections.
keyTakeaways: Most cell death in untreated HIV-1 happens to uninfected cells, creating a massive biological paradox.
The lymph nodes act as a 'firetrap' where inflammatory crises cause widespread collateral damage.
Cellular alarm systems evolved to protect us can be hijacked and turned into weapons of mass architectural destruction.

vocab.meaning: A fiery, highly inflammatory type of programmed cell death that affects uninfected cells sitting near the site of an infection.
A microscopic sensory protein inside human cells that acts as an alarm system to detect rogue viral DNA.
A tiny bean-shaped organ of the immune system that acts as a filtering station and a battleground during infections.
A crucial white blood cell that coordinates the immune response, which HIV targets and depletes.
